prompt: In a soft watercolor illustration, a school gymnasium buzzes with quiet anticipation during a science fair. On the left, a girl in a yellow raincoat stands proudly beside her project, a glass terrarium filled with moss. She is pointing at a small fern inside the glass case, drawing the attention of a boy in blue overalls who leans in closely to inspect the plant life. In the center, a teacher with silver hair sits on a folding chair, observing the scene with a gentle smile while holding a clipboard. Next to the teacher, a golden retriever rests its head on its paws, seemingly asleep amidst the academic chaos. On the right, a student wearing thick glasses holds a bubbling beaker, carefully handing it to a classmate in a striped shirt who reaches out with both hands to receive the experiment. The background features blurred banners and other indistinct tables, keeping the focus on these six distinct figures. There is no digital text or signage visible in the scene. The girl in the yellow raincoat maintains an upright posture, showcasing her work. The boy in blue overalls exhibits curiosity through his forward lean. The teacher remains seated and relaxed. The interaction between the girl and the boy centers on her pointing gesture and his attentive gaze. The second interaction occurs on the right, where the student with glasses transfers the beaker to the classmate in the striped shirt. The golden retriever lies calmly next to the seated teacher, adding warmth to the composition. The glass terrarium sits securely on the table, reflecting the soft light. The beaker glows with a faint green hue as it changes hands. Every element blends seamlessly into the wash of colors, capturing a fleeting moment of learning and connection without any harsh lines or artificial labels.
